ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High white-to-black ratio, approximately 9:1, dominated by a large high-intensity central region and a narrow low-intensity border.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field centrally; narrow black perimeter banding along the trailing edges; concentrated low-intensity mottling at the base of the fluke extending upward from the peduncle; scattered small-scale dark focal spots in the right-central lobe area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 70 degrees and a vertical depth occupying roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of serrations increases from the median notch toward the distal tips, reaching peak amplitude at the outermost margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-curving trajectory; the trailing edge maintains a concave curve near the median notch and transitions to a convex curve toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters (barnacles) detected primarily on the distal tips of both lobes and along the lower lateral margins of the peduncle.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine vertical linear disruptions on the upper-right lobe surface; more pronounced dark-intensity rake-like marks on the outer right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at both fluke tips; significant irregular scarring and dark-to-light transition mapping on the peduncle base.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct isolated dark circular spot in the middle-right white field; irregular dark pixel cluster near the lower-center of the right lobe.
